items.title: Week 0: Scratch
items.reflection: Learned foundational programming concepts (sequencing, loops, conditionals, variables, events) through visual block-based programming, before touching any text-based syntax.

items.title: Week 1: C
items.reflection: Learned to compile and debug C programs, working with variables, types, conditionals, loops, functions, and command-line arguments.

items.title: Week 2: Arrays
items.reflection: Learned to work with arrays and strings as sequences of characters, plus an introduction to cryptography concepts (basic ciphers) as a motivating application.

items.title: Week 3: Algorithms
items.reflection: Learned algorithmic complexity (Big O notation), searching algorithms (linear and binary search), several sorting algorithms (bubble, selection, merge sort), and recursion.

items.title: Week 4: Memory
items.reflection: Learned how memory actually works: pointers, memory addresses, dynamic allocation with malloc/free, the stack vs. the heap, and using Valgrind to catch memory leaks.

items.title: Week 5: Data Structures
items.reflection: Learned to build dynamic data structures from pointers and structs: linked lists, trees, tries, and hash tables.

items.title: Week 6: Python
items.reflection: Transitioned from C to Python: dynamic typing, exceptions, libraries, and how much the same algorithmic ideas look different in a higher-level language.

items.title: Week 7: SQL
items.reflection: Learned relational database design and SQL: writing SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries, joins, indexes, and why parameterized queries matter for avoiding SQL injection.

items.title: Week 8: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
items.reflection: Learned how the web works under the hood: HTTP requests and responses, structuring pages with HTML, styling them with CSS and Bootstrap, and making them interactive with JavaScript and the DOM.
